description:
1. Create an internal or Marketplace-published app in [Slack app settings](https://api.slack.com/apps)
2. Enable the [user scopes](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools) for the tools you need
3. Allow the callback URL used by Login
4. Copy Client ID and Client Secret, save, then choose Login

en.description:
1. Create an internal or Marketplace-published app in [Slack app settings](https://api.slack.com/apps)
2. Enable the [user scopes](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools) for the tools you need
3. Allow the callback URL used by Login
4. Copy Client ID and Client Secret, save, then choose Login

zh-CN.description:
1. 在 [Slack 应用设置](https://api.slack.com/apps)创建内部应用或已上架 Marketplace 的应用
2. 开通所需工具对应的[用户权限](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools)
3. 将登录使用的回调 URL 加入允许列表
4. 复制 Client ID 和 Client Secret，保存后点击登录

zh-TW.description:
1. 在 [Slack 應用設定](https://api.slack.com/apps)建立內部應用或已上架 Marketplace 的應用
2. 開通所需工具對應的[使用者權限](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools)
3. 將登入使用的回呼 URL 加入允許清單
4. 複製 Client ID 和 Client Secret，儲存後選擇登入

de.description:
1. Erstelle eine interne oder im Marketplace veröffentlichte App in den [Slack-App-Einstellungen](https://api.slack.com/apps)
2. Aktiviere die benötigten [Benutzerberechtigungen](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools)
3. Erlaube die von der Anmeldung verwendete Callback-URL
4. Kopiere Client-ID und Client-Geheimnis, speichere und wähle Anmelden

es.description:
1. Crea una aplicación interna o publicada en Marketplace en [Slack](https://api.slack.com/apps)
2. Activa los [permisos de usuario](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools) de las herramientas necesarias
3. Permite la URL de retorno que usa el inicio de sesión
4. Copia el ID y el secreto del cliente, guarda e inicia sesión

fr.description:
1. Créez une application interne ou publiée sur Marketplace dans [Slack](https://api.slack.com/apps)
2. Activez les [autorisations utilisateur](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools) des outils nécessaires
3. Autorisez l’URL de retour utilisée pour la connexion
4. Copiez l’ID et le secret du client, enregistrez, puis connectez-vous

ja.description:
1. [Slack アプリ設定](https://api.slack.com/apps)で社内アプリまたは Marketplace 公開アプリを作成
2. 必要なツールの[ユーザー権限](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools)を有効化
3. ログインで使用するコールバック URL を許可
4. Client ID と Client Secret をコピーして保存し、ログインを選択

ko.description:
1. [Slack 앱 설정](https://api.slack.com/apps)에서 내부 앱 또는 Marketplace에 게시된 앱 생성
2. 필요한 도구의 [사용자 권한](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools) 활성화
3. 로그인에 사용하는 콜백 URL 허용
4. Client ID와 Client Secret을 복사해 저장한 후 로그인 선택

pt-BR.description:
1. Crie um aplicativo interno ou publicado no Marketplace nas [configurações do Slack](https://api.slack.com/apps)
2. Ative os [escopos de usuário](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools) das ferramentas necessárias
3. Permita a URL de retorno usada pelo login
4. Copie o ID e o segredo do cliente, salve e escolha Entrar

ru.description:
1. Создайте внутреннее приложение или приложение Marketplace в [настройках Slack](https://api.slack.com/apps)
2. Включите [пользовательские разрешения](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes-needed-on-user-token-for-different-tools) для нужных инструментов
3. Разрешите URL обратного вызова, используемый для входа
4. Скопируйте ID и секрет клиента, сохраните и выберите вход
